population_definition: All human identities in the corporate identity provider with status active, excluding service principals. Explicitly excludes enclave identities.
source_system: corporate IdP (Okta or Entra ID, corporate tenant)
coverage_basis: 890 of 890 active corporate human identities; no exclusions. OUT OF THE CMMC ASSESSMENT BOUNDARY - this control is not scored by an assessor and does not reach the SPRS derivation, which is the point of keeping it a separate record. The corporate IdP records no per-account change timestamp we trust, so started_at_basis is equals_detected throughout and every duration derived from this control understates the true window.
